query: SELECT a.conversation_id, a.choice, split_part(a.question_id, '.', 2) AS "trade!", (SELECT p.town FROM intake.property p WHERE p.homeowner_id = h.id AND left(replace(p.id::text, '-', ''), 12) = split_part(a.question_id, '.', 3) LIMIT 1) AS town FROM intake.intake_answer a JOIN intake.conversation c ON c.id = a.conversation_id JOIN intake.homeowner h ON h.id = c.homeowner_id WHERE h.contact_id = $1 AND c.closed_at IS NULL AND a.question_id LIKE 'job.%' ORDER BY a.answered_at DESC LIMIT 1
